subject: Intro: OEM embed opportunity with Atlas Insights
messages:
From: Emily Zhou <emily@atlasconsult.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kevin Park <kevin@keystone.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: OEM/embedding Redwood for Keystone Insights

Hi Vanessa —

Great to meet you virtually last week. Keystone is building a vertical analytics product (financial services compliance workflows) and asked us to evaluate embedding a best-in-class LLM for on-product summarization, embeddings search, and private inference. We think Redwood's runtime and private deployment options are a strong fit.

High level asks from Keystone:
- White-label embedding into their product UI with co-branded licensing
- On-prem / VPC option for sensitive customers
- Audit logs + KMS integration
- SLAs for latency for 95th percentile requests

Can you share a short OEM playbook / recommended commercial constructs? We can coordinate a technical deep-dive next week. Kevin (cc) will handle procurement questions.

Thanks,
Emily
Principal, Atlas Consulting
Attachments: example_product_sketch.png (image stub)
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhou <emily@atlasconsult.com>
Cc: Kevin Park <kevin@keystone.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: OEM/embedding Redwood for Keystone Insights

Emily — thanks for the intro and outline. Really excited by the opportunity. Quick answers up front: yes, we support both white-label OEM licensing and private/VPC deployments; we have KMS integrations and offer an enterprise security package that includes audit logs you mentioned.

I'll share a compact playbook and a draft mutual action plan for timelines, plus a tiered commercial model that covers hosted vs. dedicated vs. private pricing. Proposed next step: 60-minute technical workshop (arch + APIs + SDKs) and a short legal/pricing sync the same week.

Attaching an OEM Playbook summary and a starter MAP. Let me know availability — Wed/Thu afternoon PST work for our infra/solutions lead (Dev and Sergio cc'd).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0129

Forwarding the thread to get us prepped. A few internal notes:
- Technical scope: embeddings search + summarization + on-device (customer-managed) inference paths. Need to verify model size targets; Keystone mentioned compliance customers who will require FIPS/KMS.
- Ops: estimate capacity for a single-tenant Dedicated pool for initial launch (50 qps burst, 6k tokens/session typical).
- Commercial: Atlas asked about co-branded licensing and revenue share possibility. 

Vanessa — I drafted a short answer set for common customer asks and a proposed MAP with milestones for design sign-off, security review, pilot, and GA. See attached quick notes.

Sergio

From: Kevin Park <kevin@keystone.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Emily Zhou <emily@atlasconsult.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: OEM/embedding Redwood for Keystone Insights

Thanks Vanessa/Emily — a couple of procurement/security clarifications from our side before the workshop: 
1) Does Redwood allow redistribution as part of a white-label product (we need a clause for OEM redistribution rights)?
2) Pricing: are there per-seat or per-instance minimums for private deployments?
3) Support & SLA: what are the escalation paths and credits for missed latency SLAs?

Also attaching a one-page requirements list from Keystone's compliance team. Would prefer a call Mon/Tue next week for technical.

—Kevin
Head of Product, Keystone Analytics
Attachments: Keystone_Reqs_1pager.pdf (attachment stub)
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Kevin Park <kevin@keystone.ai>, Emily Zhou <emily@atlasconsult.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: OEM/embedding Redwood for Keystone Insights

Kevin — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers:
- Redistribution: yes, we have an OEM addendum that grants redistribution rights under specified usage and royalty terms. We'll surface standard language but are open to negotiation for major partners.
- Pricing: private/VPC deployments are quoted per-dedicated-pool (flat monthly commit) + token/throughput overage; no per-seat license by default. For large ISVs we can add seat-based UI entitlements as an add-on.
- SLA & support: standard enterprise SLA includes 99.9% uptime and P95 latency targets by route; credits and an escalation workflow (SE -> Solutions Eng -> Partner Ops -> Legal) are included in the contract.

Attached is a starter mutual action plan with milestones and a suggested agenda for the technical workshop (integration patterns, data flows, KMS/HSM options, fallback routing). Proposed workshop slot: Tue 29 Jul 2025, 10:00–11:30 PDT. If that works, I’ll send calendar invites and a pre-read.

Notes for our team: Sergio, please prepare a short benchmark for P95 latency on 8xA100 vs quantized on-prem instance; Dev, please bring a summary of KMS integration steps and SDK embed samples. Marissa, please prepare commercial options (rev-share vs license + support).

Best,
Vanessa
From: Emily Zhou <emily@atlasconsult.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Kevin Park <kevin@keystone.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jul 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: OEM/embedding Redwood for Keystone Insights

Looks great — Tue 29 Jul 10:00 PDT works for our team. Kevin has circulated the compliance one-pager internally and they flagged two follow-ups: (a) export controls for model weights (must be clear for on-prem installs), and (b) SOC2 evidence for audit.

We'll treat the MAP as live and expect a kickoff agenda + attendee list. Thanks for the rapid turnaround.

See you Tue — Emily
Principal, Atlas Consulting
